name: explaining
description: The "Todd way" output style: makes explanatory prose readable by someone without the writer's context — term discipline, grounding, multi-actor flows rendered to validated HTML, and a blind-reader pass before delivery — folded together with the built-in Concise rules so it is always on rather than waiting to be invoked. Ships its runtime scripts in tools/. Rules retained only if they beat baseline in an isolated A/B eval; refuted candidates excluded. The skill this replaced is frozen under archive/skills/explaining/.
